messages.author: c2ea4509eebe336a
messages.subject: SVM (e1071) from Java
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to use the library e1071 from my Java classes with Renjin. My dependencies in my pom.xml file look like that:

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.renjin</groupId>
      <artifactId>renjin-appengine</artifactId>
      <version>LATEST</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.renjin.cran</groupId>
      <artifactId>e1071</artifactId>
      <version>LATEST</version>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>

During the creation of the ScriptEngine using the AppEngineContextFactory, I get the following exception: 

org.renjin.eval.EvalException: org.renjin.cran.class.class
at org.renjin.primitives.packaging.ClasspathPackage.loadClass(ClasspathPackage.java:49)
at org.renjin.primitives.packaging.Namespace.importDynamicLibrary(Namespace.java:179)
...
at org.mortbay.thread.QueuedThreadPool$PoolThread.run(QueuedThreadPool.java:582)
Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: org.renjin.cran.class.class
at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(URLClassLoader.java:372)
... 60 more
WARNING: Failed to import dynLib entries for class, expect subsequent failures
org.renjin.eval.EvalException: org.renjin.cran.e1071.e1071
at org.renjin.primitives.packaging.ClasspathPackage.loadClass(ClasspathPackage.java:49)
at org.renjin.primitives.packaging.Namespace.importDynamicLibrary(Namespace.java:179)
...
at org.mortbay.thread.QueuedThreadPool$PoolThread.run(QueuedThreadPool.java:582)
Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: org.renjin.cran.e1071.e1071
at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(URLClassLoader.java:372)
... 54 more
WARNING: Failed to import dynLib entries for e1071, expect subsequent failures

When I use the Renjin console, I am able to load the library and a model, but using the predict function causes "Error: org.renjin.cran.e1071.e1071".

When I am using the ScriptEngine without the e1071 library, it works without any problem. I saw a similar post from someone using randomForest from his Java code.

Any idea what the problem could be and if there is a workaround? Is it because I use the renjin-appengine? Or is because some c++ code was not ported yet?

Thanks for your help!

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: SVM (e1071) from Java
parts:
Hi Joël,
It looks like e1071 has C++ code which our toolchain does not yet compile. (Issue #119)

The message you're seeing is only a warning because the Java class that will eventually contain the compiled C/C++ code is missing.

If there are functions in e1071 that don't rely on the C/C++ code, then they should work fine, but unfortunately any functions which rely on C/C++ for this package will fail. 

We're making good progress on the native code compiler, but unfortunatley for this package at least, we're not there yet.

Alex

Le lundi 1 février 2016 22:57:47 UTC+8, Alexander Bertram a écrit :
Hi Joël,
It looks like e1071 has C++ code which our toolchain does not yet compile. (Issue #119)

The message you're seeing is only a warning because the Java class that will eventually contain the compiled C/C++ code is missing.

If there are functions in e1071 that don't rely on the C/C++ code, then they should work fine, but unfortunately any functions which rely on C/C++ for this package will fail. 

We're making good progress on the native code compiler, but unfortunatley for this package at least, we're not there yet.

Alex
